method: Open reviewed source; change only hinge custom properties through generator helper; write all existing datablocks at same path without remapping or fake-user changes, retaining unused packed tiles; reopen final source and compare semantic content. Both base and evaluated mesh coordinates/topology/normals/UV/attributes, material graphs, packed images, object hierarchy/transforms/modifiers/constraints and scene units are captured.

legacy_hinge_custom_properties.runtime_status: Articulation proposal only; no animation/controller/gameplay implemented

current_hinge_custom_properties.runtime_status: Articulation proposal only; no animation/controller/gameplay implemented
current_hinge_custom_properties.hinge_hint_blender_source: Blender source frame: negative rotation about local +Z opens outward.
current_hinge_custom_properties.hinge_hint_gltf_yup: Native GLB Y-up frame: negative rotation about local +Y opens outward.
current_hinge_custom_properties.hinge_coordinate_conversion: Blender source (X,Y,Z) -> native glTF/GLB (X,Z,-Y); custom-property vectors retain their explicitly named frame.

serialization_note: Blender data-block library write preserves all asset data including five otherwise orphaned packed staff tiles. Editor session WindowManager/Screen/WorkSpace blocks are excluded; this check does not certify preservation of editor window/layout state. Runtime session IDs and empty renderer-initialized custom-property groups are excluded from semantic comparison.
